about:
Alpha Custom Apparel operates from West Bend, Wisconsin. The company was founded by Christina Ongert, who serves as president and owner, drawing on 27 years of fashion and manufacturing experience. Ongert established the business to assist independent fashion brands, organizations, companies, and e‑commerce retailers with sourcing, textile production, and broader manufacturing needs.

The firm manages the full supply chain — design and development, fabric and trim sourcing, sample creation, bulk production, packaging, quality‑control checks, and delivery logistics. It leverages a global network of manufacturing partners while emphasizing localized decoration and production to reduce costs, emissions, and lead times. Product categories span athletic and team apparel, promotional and hardline items, retail and corporate apparel, construction‑grade hi‑vis gear, and managed company stores.

Clients range from independent fashion labels and online retailers to schools, nonprofits, and corporate brands. Notable partnerships include Good Karma Brands and the ESPN Tailgate at the Tundra Trio in Green Bay, where Alpha supplies branded giveaways such as hats, blankets, and fans. The company also supports local organizations like West Bend High Schools, the Wisconsin 911 Memorial, and various community nonprofits.

Alpha differentiates itself through an innovative design approach and a stated goal of cutting concept‑to‑completion time in half. The leadership team positions the company as a creative partner that brings fashion‑forward thinking to industries that traditionally treat apparel as purely functional, aiming to empower anyone with a creative idea to launch or grow a brand.
